title: DSSSB MTS & JE Recruitment 2026
summary: Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board (DSSSB) has released a notification on its official website for the recruitment of Junior Engineer (Electrical), Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS), MTS – Aaya (Female) and MTS (General Duty) in various departments Posts. This recruitment is for 1260 positions. DSSSB Application Form has started on 12 November 2026 & the candidates can apply until 11 December 2026 . Minimum age required is 18 Years & The Maximum Age Is 27 Years as on 01 June 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for DSSSB MTS & JE Recruitment 2026. which has given below. (Advt No. : 06/2026)
